title: HB563 (132st Legislature (2017-2018)): Prohibit transferring firearm while background check pending

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Ohio) (gun-policy Stage 5, Ohio); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Ohio text (As Introduced (00_IN), ; official copy, https://search-prod.lis.state.oh.us/api/v2/general_assembly_132/legislation/hb563/00_IN/pdf/ (Open States text id 90121656))
provenance.note: As introduced text (00_IN). No passage vote text; existing trigger-lock sentence in R.C. 2923.25 is unchanged and not quoted.

operative_text: Section 1 (R.C. 2923.25): Each federally licensed firearms dealer shall comply with the requirements of 18 U.S.C. 922(t). Notwithstanding 18 U.S.C. 922(t)(1)(B), no federally licensed firearms dealer shall transfer a firearm to any person unless one of the following applies: (1) The national instant criminal background check system has provided the federally licensed firearms dealer with a unique identification number. (2) The national instant criminal background check system has not provided the federally licensed firearms dealer with a unique identification number and thirty days have elapsed since the date the federally licensed firearms dealer contacted the national instant criminal background check system.
